page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.re6.52xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 208 dedicated physical cores utilizing Intel Xeon 8269CL processors, with a 1.0 thread-per-core configuration. The instance is equipped with 3072.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 14.77 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, requiring external network-attached storage for persistent data. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the hardware profile represents a high-density memory allocation designed for massive workloads, trading off local storage and GPU capabilities to maximize RAM capacity per vCPU.

Given the substantial memory footprint and high core count, the ecs.re6.52xlarge is engineered for memory-intensive enterprise applications. Suitable workloads include large-scale in-memory databases, SAP HANA deployments, massive caching layers, heavy data analytics, and enterprise resource planning systems that require substantial RAM without GPU acceleration.
